question: Can a pot be said to be merely a pot and nothing more in this framework?
premises: A pot is a common example of a limited object.
One might claim it is only what it appears to be.
The doctrine asserts a deeper Śiva-nature in all things.
inference: The challenge is to state whether the pot is only such and not Śiva-natured.
plain_english: Let it be said here: is a pot merely of that such kind alone?
